test_real_table_and_headers.title: test_real_table_and_headers
test_real_table_and_headers.code:
def test_real_table_and_headers():
    table = cli.create_table([])
    assert isinstance(table, Table)
    assert table.title == "People"
    assert [c.header for c in table.columns] == ["Name", "Age", "City"]

test_row_values_and_order.title: test_row_values_and_order
test_row_values_and_order.code:
def test_row_values_and_order():
    table = cli.create_table([("Zoe", 0, "Lima"), ("Ari", 120, "Rome")])
    assert table.row_count == 2
    assert [[str(cell) for cell in c.cells] for c in table.columns] == [["Zoe", "Ari"], ["0", "120"], ["Lima", "Rome"]]

test_show_table.title: test_show_table
test_show_table.code:
def test_show_table(capsys):
    cli.show_table([("Rene", 44, "Tokyo")])
    text = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert all(word in text for word in ["People", "Name", "Age", "City", "Rene", "44", "Tokyo"])

test_cli_table.title: test_cli_table
test_cli_table.code:
def test_cli_table():
    result = invoke([])
    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
    assert all(word in result.output for word in ["People", "Alice", "30", "London", "Bob", "25", "Paris"])

test_unicode_cells.title: test_unicode_cells
test_unicode_cells.code:
def test_unicode_cells():
    table = cli.create_table([("Müsel", 25, "México")])
    buffer = io.StringIO()
    Console(file=buffer, width=80, color_system=None).print(table)
    assert "Müsel" in buffer.getvalue() and "México" in buffer.getvalue()

test_brackets_in_cells_are_literal_text.title: test_brackets_in_cells_are_literal_text
test_brackets_in_cells_are_literal_text.code:
def test_brackets_in_cells_are_literal_text(capsys):
    cli.show_table([("[/red]", 30, "[bold]Lima[/bold]"), ("[red]", 20, "Rome")])
    text = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "[/red]" in text and "[red]" in text and "[bold]Lima[/bold]" in text

courseHelp.title: Course help
courseHelp.body:
Write your implementation above the supplied tests. Run checks the sample tests. Submit checks all supplied tests. Keep the tests and runner unchanged.

For an older saved solution, use **+** beside the editor tabs to open the current template. Copy your implementation into the new tab. Your old tab stays in place.

These templates and tests are recreations from the public descriptions. Real Typer, Click, and Rich packages are bundled for offline use. Use Run and Submit; the playground and debugger do not load the library archive. Keep script entry points inside `if __name__ == "__main__":`. The runner supports the pytest features used by the supplied tests. Select Python.

[Original Pybites exercise](https://pybitesplatform.com/bites/rich-excursion-create-beautiful-tables/)
